in_sanskrit.name: निष्ठा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A state of being steadfast, loyal, and committed to a cause or a person. It implies a strong sense of devotion and unwavering support.

in_hindi.name: निष्ठा
in_hindi.long_meaning: निष्ठाता (Nishthaata) - One who is steadfast and committed.

in_tamil.name: நிஷ்டா
in_tamil.long_meaning: நிஷ்டத்தின் (Nishattin) - One who is steadfast and firm.

in_telugu.name: నిష్ఠ
in_telugu.long_meaning: నిష్ఠము (Nishthamu) - One who is steadfast and committed.

in_marathi.name: Nishtha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Commitment, Dedication, Devotion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishtha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishtha means commitment, dedication, and devotion. It is a term used in Hinduism to describe the unwavering connection between the soul and the divine. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root nish, meaning to rest, and the suffix tha, indicating a state of being.

in_bengali.name: Nishtha

in_bengali.long_meaning: Nishtha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nishtha means commitment, dedication, and devotion. It is a term used in Hinduism to describe the unwavering connection between the soul and the divine. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root nish, meaning to rest, and the suffix tha, indicating a state of being.
